ACCEPT · seat 2 · 2026-10-26T18:12Z · PR #26272 head `cf00e778` (#26238, the count-pin sweep)

| check | reading |
|---|---|
| scope | 38 files, +256/−217, every one a `*.test.ts(x)` under `ui/`; no product source, no `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/*`, no locale pack, no `ui/.github/**`, no `ci.yml` |
| the two guards | `MetadataService.retiredObjectEnabled` / `.specKeyObjectPayload`: `accept.size` removed; the named membership facts stay (`enable` accepted, `enabled` / `_deleted` and six synonyms refused) and a no-near-spelling check (edit distance ≤ 2 over the accept set) replaces what the count stood in for |
| proof | 25 scratch spec members: 24 files old red → new green; 6 still red only at a kept derived-parity line (each a real ui gap); 8 not reached; restore left 0 spec diff |
| tests | 38 files / 891 tests at head; 12 touched packages' full suites 28011 green; app-shell and console narrowed to changed files, declared, rest left to CI |
| gates | 24 derived, 24 run, all exit 0 |
| governance | NOT governed, 473 lines ≤ 3000 |
| landing | `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` clean; test-only, so it joins no sdui package line |

**Ruling on the open question:** keep the derived ui-vs-spec parity guards red on an additive spec change. Their red names a ui gap someone must close (a missing label, consumer or declaration), which is the opposite of a brittle count; #26092 makes them run on the spec PR itself, so the spec author sees them before main does.

**Out-of-scope finding** (51 type-level `Equal` literal-union pins in 31 files, red on Type Check UI on an additive spec change): filed as its own card, linked below once created.

Seat's route: ready + auto-merge.
